messages:
paola: Incoming from the marketplace PM 11 They need a SOC2 Type II summary, the latest redacted pen-test, and a filled compliance questionnaire (Q7/Q8 highlighted). They want uploads by next Tue COB or a secure presigned URL today. Can we commit? :clock1:

ravi: I'll take point on the questionnaire answers (we've seen Q7 about KMS/HSM + Q8 data residency before). Need authoritative wording from infra/security for exact phrasing.

mike: Infra note 1: for listings we use customer-managed KMS keys in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 (for EU-facing customers). HSM is optional via our KMS provider. Sample snippet to paste into the questionnaire: `CMK in us-east-1 / CMK in eu-west-1; HSM-backed on request; key rotation enabled.`

samir: I can package the artifacts: redacted pen-test PDF, vuln scan outputs, remediation tracker CSV, and SOC2 summary letter. Will need Ellen to bless the redactions. ETA 36 hours after approval.

ben: The redacted report lives in the Vault at `vault://partners/marketplace/pen-test-2025-redacted.pdf`. I can generate an external share token once security approves.

ellen: Security here 1: policy requires removing any customer or partner IP, and masking hostnames/URLs. I can perform a redaction pass and produce a redaction log. Ill also prepare an attestation snippet we can hand the marketplace (short statement confirming SOC scope and when report was issued). I'll do the review by tomorrow AM.

paola: Marketplace said they prefer either their partner portal or presigned URLs (S3/GCS). They explicitly will not accept raw/unredacted artifacts. If portal is slow, we should have a presigned link ready. Also they need a SHA256 checksum for large bundles.

samir: Commands I'll run once I have approved files:
```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/mkt-evidence && cp /vault/partners/marketplace/*redacted* /tmp/mkt-evidence/
tar -czf redwood-marketplace-evidence-2025.tar.gz -C /tmp mkt-evidence
sha256sum redwood-marketplace-evidence-2025.tar.gz > redwood-marketplace-evidence-2025.sha256
aws s3 cp redwood-marketplace-evidence-2025.tar.gz s3://redwood-partner-uploads/marketplace/ --acl private
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-uploads/marketplace/redwood-marketplace-evidence-2025.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```

security-bot: Scheduled CI vulnerability scan finished 1 No critical CVEs detected; medium findings are being triaged in backlog. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

ravi: Do we also need to include our incident response SLA excerpt? Some marketplaces ask for IR timelines.

ellen: Good call. I'll attach a one-page IR excerpt (sanitized) and a contact point for escalations. Also adding a short note about SAML and SCIM support for integrations.

ben: I'll open the Vault share request and add @ellen and @paola as approvers; will ping when the token is created.

paola: Action list and deadlines:
- @ellen: complete redaction review + attestation snippet (due tomorrow 10:00 AM)
- @samir: bundle artifacts, generate tarball + checksum, create presigned link (due Tomorrow 6:00 PM)
- @ben: request Vault external share + add approvers (ASAP)
- @mike: confirm KMS/HSM wording and provide EU residency note (today)
- @ravi: draft questionnaire responses (Q7/Q8) and IR excerpt insertion (due Tomorrow 2:00 PM)
- @paola: submit to marketplace portal or send presigned link if portal unavailable (target Tue COB)

paola: If anyone hits blockers (redaction edge-cases, Vault approvals, or presign failures) drop them here and I'll escalate to the marketplace PM. Thanks team :pray:
